m: retas n. (√ ri, rī) a flow, stream, current, flow of rain or water, libation, RV.; AV.

flow of semen, seminal fluid, sperm, seed, RV. &c. &c. (retaḥ-√ sic or ni-√ sic or ā-√ dhā with loc., ‘to discharge semen into’, impregnate; reto-√ dhā, A., to conceive; retaso 'nte, after the discharge of s˚)
a: retas [rī-asun tuṭ ca] 1 Semen virile, seed. 2 Ved. A flow, current. 3 Progeny, offspring. 4 Quicksilver. 5 Sin (mostly Ved. in the last senses.) Comp. — dhā m. a father. — mārgaḥ the seminal duct or canal.
